sources.title: Workflow: daily alert for new jobs at target companies (Greenhouse/Lever/Ashby/Workday) to Slack
sources.text: Workflow: Schedule Trigger (daily) → Apify node (“Run an Actor and get dataset”) → IF item count > 0 → Slack.
taskExcerpts: Workflow: Schedule Trigger (daily) → Apify node (“Run an Actor and get dataset”) → IF item count > 0 → Slack.

spans.text: Sharing a simple pattern I use for tracking hiring at target companies. Workflow: Schedule Trigger (daily) → Apify node (“Run an Actor and get dataset”) → IF item count > 0 → Slack. In the Apify node, run the Actor birchwood-data/ats-job-scraper with input like:

For Workday career sites use birchwood-data/workday-jobs-scraper the same way. In the Slack node, post {{$json.title}} – {{$json.location}} – {{$json.url}} . Because the Actor remembers which jobs it has already seen between runs, each run returns only new postings, so no dedupe logic is needed in n8n. A quiet day costs almost nothing, since the Actors are pay-per-result (Workday is $0.002 per returned job). Actors: Greenhouse, Lever & Ashby Job Scraper | ATS Jobs API · Apify and Workday Jobs Scraper | myworkdayjobs.com API · Apify Disclosure: I built both Actors. Happy to share the workflow JSON if that’s useful, and feedback on what to add next is welcome.
